test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All flowers are blue.

Some blues are balls.

No ball is red.

**Conclusions:**

I: No flowers is red.

II: All flowers are balls.

III: Few balls are blue.
solution:
Given Statements:

All flowers are blue.

Some blues are balls.

No ball is red.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/179f9fa538aeff85cd1b0d6db45c93296373f5eb2874f505ac02b92193b6092b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7f695bc1e17e6519bab6bae5e939937e69322dcd5bbae51e01faef8cf2fc209.png] 

Conclusions:

I: No flowers is red. - **False **(Because there is no direct relation between flowers and red, so it can be possible but not definite)

II: All flowers are balls. - False (Because there is no direct relation between flowers and balls, so it can be possible but not definite)

III: Few balls are blue. - **True **(Because Some blues are balls given. So, Few balls are also blue)

So, Only III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only ****III follows".**
